meta.title: News and press
meta.description: Company news, press coverage and milestones of AZAFCO International, plus Egyptian fish-sector news from named sources, each with its date.

hero.title: News, press and milestones
hero.intro: Visits, media coverage and milestones from AZAFCO International, with industry news from named sources. Every item shows its date and source.

press.title: Visits and media coverage
press.intro: Official visits to our plant and press and TV coverage of AZAFCO International.

founding.title: AZAFCO International is founded
founding.text: We were founded in Kafr El Sheikh and began packing and exporting fresh fish.

baltim.title: Our first plant, in Baltim
baltim.text: We opened our first plant in the Baltim Industrial Zone, Kafr El Sheikh.

motobas.title: Our new plant, in Motobas
motobas.text: We opened our new plant in the Motobas Industrial Zone, Kafr El Sheikh.

iso.title: ISO certified
iso.text: We hold ISO certificates for quality, environmental, and occupational health and safety management, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

industry.title: Egypt's fish sector in the news
industry.intro: Reports on Egyptian fisheries and on Kafr El Sheikh, the governorate where our plant is located.
industry.note: Figures in this section come from the named sources, as of the date shown. They are not AZAFCO data.

governor_visit.title: Governor of Kafr El Sheikh visits our Motobas plant
governor_visit.summary: Maj. Gen. Dr. Alaa Abdel Moaty, Governor of Kafr El Sheikh, toured our plant in the Motobas Industrial Zone as part of the governorate's work to support the fish industry and exports.

press_feature.title: Feature in Dar Al-Sharq Al-Awsat
press_feature.summary: The newspaper Dar Al-Sharq Al-Awsat published a profile of AZAFCO International and its chairman, covering the company's work in fresh fish exports.

tv_program.title: “Helwa Ya Baladi” TV episode on AZAFCO International
tv_program.summary: The Misr Al Balad TV programme “Helwa Ya Baladi” aired a special episode on our fresh fish packing and export work.

egypt_ranking.title: Egypt ranks first in Africa in fisheries, says the Agriculture Minister
egypt_ranking.summary: Meeting the Gambian Minister for Fisheries, Egypt's Minister of Agriculture, El-Sayed El-Quseir, said Egypt ranks first in Africa and sixth in the world in fisheries.

kafr_el_sheikh_production.title: Kafr El Sheikh produces about half of Egypt's fish
kafr_el_sheikh_production.summary: Al-Ahram Gate reported that Kafr El Sheikh produces about 50% of Egypt's fish, around 800,000 tonnes a year, and that aquaculture makes up 70% of the governorate's production.

ghalioun_project.title: Ghalioun fish farm opens in Kafr El Sheikh
ghalioun_project.summary: President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi opened the Ghalioun fish industrial city in Kafr El Sheikh: a fish farm of about 4,000 feddans with 1,359 fish and shrimp ponds, hatcheries, and plants for fish processing, feed and ice.
